summary: Full end-to-end validation of the new 'Fetch from SAP' inbound-delivery button on Confirmed GRNs (iter 158). Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass (auth guard, 404s, real live-SAP positive fetch of PO 29368 -> Inbound Delivery '52897', per_po flipped to manually_confirmed=True + sap_sync_status='posted'; negative case with fake bill 'NONEXISTENT-BILL-999' returns job status='failed' with clear error, no crash; Pending & Confirmed list endpoints unaffected). Frontend: Playwright e2e against the real preview URL confirmed - button visible only on Confirmed tab (0 buttons on Pending, as required), e.stopPropagation blocks row-click dialog, 'Fetching from SAP...' disabled loading state, after ~10s row updates to show '52897' + 'Manually confirmed from SAP' badge + 'Posted' green status, and detail dialog also shows both. One minor cosmetic bug found: literal '\u2014' text instead of em-dash in the blank inbound-delivery cell.

ui_bugs.component: GrnApprovalPage - Confirmed table SAP Inbound Delivery # cell
ui_bugs.issue: Literal string '\u2014' rendered as text instead of an em-dash (—). JSX line 874 uses \u2014 which is an escaped-sequence string literal, not a JS-evaluated unicode escape. Visible in every Confirmed row that still has a blank inbound delivery (e.g. XGPEJ2, MU7DE2, T49E7Q...). Fix: replace with {'\u2014'} or the literal em-dash character '—'.

action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: fix `\u2014` -> `{'\u2014'}` (or literal '—') in GrnApprovalPage.jsx around line 874 so the em-dash placeholder renders correctly for blank inbound-delivery cells.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend logic is clean: PO-level match uses PO number + exact supplier bill + item-code cross-check, handles multi-PO shipments, distinguishes no-match vs ambiguous, never raises for per-PO errors so partial success is possible.
manually_confirm_inbound_delivery correctly flips overall sap_sync_status only when ALL per_po entries are posted (mirrors finalize_goods_receipt's all-or-nothing rule).

Frontend polls with 40 iterations x 3s = 120s ceiling; live SAP query on this analytics report can take 30-100s+ - a slow SAP tenant could theoretically exceed this. Consider extending to 60 iterations x 3s (180s) for safety. Not blocking - main-agent live-verified ~90s previously.
Backend job_store uses asyncio.to_thread wrapping which is correct given the sync SAP client.
